title: Agentic Hazard Mapper: Emulating Expert Map-Making with AI Agents for Risk Communication
abstract: arXiv:2610.32738v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Hazard maps are essential tools for public risk communication, preparedness, and evacuation planning, yet effective cartographic design is not always ensured due to limited access to cartographic expertise across local governments and communities. We present Agentic Hazard Mapper, a multi-agent system that automates hazard-map production by emulating professional cartographic workflows and iterative design trade-offs while adapting design decisions to different data, locations, and hazard contexts. We conducted a formative study with map experts to inform the system design, followed by a user study and interviews with map experts and hazard practitioners. The generated maps improved participants' spatial understanding and evacuation-planning performance, reduced perceived workload and task completion time, and were generally preferred over corresponding municipal maps. translated_title: 智能体灾害地图绘制器：利用AI智能体模拟专家制图以服务风险传播
translated_abstract: 灾害地图是公共风险传播、备灾和疏散规划的重要工具，但由于地方政府和社区获取制图专业知识的机会有限，有效的地图设计并非总能得到保证。我们提出了Agentic Hazard Mapper，这是一个多智能体系统，通过模拟专业制图工作流程和迭代设计权衡来自动化灾害地图的生产，同时使设计决策能够适应不同的数据、地点和灾害情境。我们与地图专家开展了形成性研究以指导系统设计，随后进行了用户研究，并对地图专家和灾害从业者进行了访谈。系统生成的地图提高了参与者的空间理解能力和疏散规划表现，降低了感知工作量和任务完成时间，并且总体上比相应的市政地图更受青睐。我们进一步讨论了人类监督以及跨用户和社区的适应性。
tldr: 本文提出Agentic Hazard Mapper多智能体系统，通过模拟专业制图师的工作流程和设计权衡来自动生成灾害地图，其生成的地图在空间理解、疏散规划效果和工作负荷方面均优于现有市政地图。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Agentic Hazard Mapper, a multi-agent system that automates hazard-map creation by emulating professional cartographic workflows and iterative design trade-offs, with generated maps outperforming municipal maps in spatial understanding, evacuation-planning performance, and perceived workload.
